input.content: A services agreement between Northfield Logistics and Calder Retail was signed on 3 March 2025. Clause 12 lets either party terminate for convenience with 60 days' written notice, and says notice is effective on the day it is received. Calder's notice was received on 10 June 2025. All the facts you need are in this message. Reply in the console: on what date does the agreement end, and may Northfield stop performing before that date?

rubric.criteria: States that the agreement ends on 9 August 2025
States that Northfield may not stop performing before the termination date

verifier_metadata.gold_response: The agreement ends on 9 August 2025, 60 days after the notice was received on 10 June 2025. Northfield must keep performing until then.

input.content: A supply contract caps each party's total liability at the fees paid in the 12 months before the claim. The cap does not apply to breaches of confidentiality. The buyer paid 240,000 USD in the last 12 months. It claims 500,000 USD for late delivery and 150,000 USD for a confidentiality breach. All the facts you need are in this message. Reply in the console: what is the most the buyer can recover on each claim, and in total?

rubric.criteria: States that recovery for late delivery is limited to 240,000 USD
States that the confidentiality claim of 150,000 USD is not capped
States that the total recoverable amount is 390,000 USD

verifier_metadata.gold_response: Late delivery is capped at 240,000 USD. The 150,000 USD confidentiality claim falls outside the cap. The total is 390,000 USD.

input.content: A lease runs from 1 January 2024 for five years. The tenant may renew once for three years by written notice given at least 180 days before the term ends. input.content: An employment contract has a non-compete of 12 months after termination, limited to the country where the employee worked and to direct competitors. The employee worked only in Portugal and left on 30 April 2025. On 1 September 2025 they joined a direct competitor in Spain. All the facts you need are in this message. Reply in the console: is the employee in breach of the non-compete, and why?

rubric.criteria: States that the employee is not in breach
Gives the geographic limit to Portugal as the reason
Notes that the 12-month period was still running on 1 September 2025

verifier_metadata.gold_response: No breach. The clause was still running on 1 September 2025, but it only covers Portugal, and the new job is in Spain.

input.content: A share purchase agreement requires warranty claims to be notified within 18 months of completion and only allows claims above 25,000 EUR each. Completion was on 15 January 2024. The buyer notified a 40,000 EUR claim on 20 June 2025 and a 10,000 EUR claim on 1 March 2025. All the facts you need are in this message. Reply in the console: which of the two claims can proceed?

rubric.criteria: States that the 40,000 EUR claim can proceed
States that the 10,000 EUR claim cannot proceed because it is below the 25,000 EUR threshold

verifier_metadata.gold_response: Only the 40,000 EUR claim can proceed: it was notified within 18 months (deadline 15 July 2025) and exceeds the threshold. The 10,000 EUR claim was in time but is below 25,000 EUR.
